sam: Tiny impromptu poll  afternoon editor+snack showdown. Reply with the number or add a wild card. Options: 1) VSCode + chocolate chip cookie 2) Vim + apple slices 3) Neovim + popcorn 4) Emacs + yogurt parfait
jin: 3) Neovim + popcorn for me. Easy to nibble while skimming logs. :popcorn:
olivia: 1) VSCode + cookie. Classic combo. :cookie:
mike: 2) Vim + apple slices. Keeps me awake without the sugar crash. :apple:
poll-bot: Poll created  React 1️⃣ 2️⃣ 3️⃣ 4️⃣ to vote. Poll auto-closes in 1 hour.
sam: quick tally so far:
```
1: olivia
2: mike
3: jin
4: (none)
```
jin: wildcard idea: 5) Micro-IDE + trail mix (for the multipurpose snacker).
olivia: if 5 wins we demand trail mix in the kitchen. :raised_hands:
mike: note: popcorn near mechanical keyboards is a liability. napkins recommended.
sam: closing soon, i'll post final winner and a tiny sticker mockup: "Snack & Ship" series. Low-stakes, high morale. :tada:
